name: Mother Puckers | 200mg Live Rosin Gummies | Balance Bomb
description:
Recover. Reset. Reload.

Balance Bomb is the ultimate bounce-back edible in our Supercharged Super Sours lineup. Built for recovery, these chews blend the sweet satisfaction of six bold fruit flavors—Orange, Watermelon, Blue Raspberry, Black Cherry, Strawberry, and Green Apple—with a potent, feel-good cannabinoid mix designed to help you recharge without crashing.

Each piece is infused with 200mg THC Live Rosin, 100mg CBD, and 50mg CBG, offering a Sativa-dominant, full-spectrum experience that calms the mind, soothes the body, and gets you back to baseline. Whether you're coming down from the gym, the grind, or a night that went too hard—this one’s for you.

Loud flavors. Loud effects. Loud brand. Vegan, gluten-free, heat-resistant. #PAFO

Key Details

Cannabinoids: 200mg THC + 100mg CBD + 50mg CBG

Strain Type: Sativa

Infusion: Live Rosin (Full-Spectrum)

Texture: Soft, chewy, sour-coated

Flavor Notes: Sweet upfront, sour pop, juicy fruit finish

Dietary: Vegan, Gluten-Free, Heat-Resistant

Format: 20 pieces per pouch (10mg THC each)
